title: Buddy Petit and the search for a record of him
summary: Miller wishes Petit had recorded; interviewer mentions rumours and Little Dad as a possible source.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well nobody's found it yet. I've heard talk of his record. He's supposed to have made, but you never know.
But I mean, who should have it?
Little Dad, you might ask Little Dad. Little Dad what he plays? Banjo.
Yeah I know him, what come of him?
He's living up near where Willie Humphrey lives.

Yeah. Well anyway, he's supposed to know about it. And various people have talked about it, but I don't know. You can't always tell what to believe, you know. That's right. You heard so many stories about him.
